inspection_summary: Inspected all 561 normalized lines against the frozen identity. The article develops two linked uses of mollified mean squares: quantitative control of zeros of zeta derivatives and a lower bound for distinct zeta zeros. The prose supports the mechanism-level segmentation, while many displayed fractions, superscripts, and layouts are extraction-degraded; affected units explicitly require scan/formula verification and no missing notation has been reconstructed.
